$comment: THE asset library — single source of truth for the visual layer. One record flows to the Scene Director's vocabulary (packages/scene/src/catalog.ts), the renderer (apps/web fetches GET /assets/library), and the extractor (scripts/extract-assets.py produces the served PNG from each `from`). To ADD an asset: add a record (with a `from`), then `npm run assets:extract`. INTERIM library: CC0 Kenney 'Tiny' trio (Tiny Town, Tiny Dungeon) + Tiny Creatures (CC0) — all 16x16, mutually cohesive. Pixel Crawler kept under raw-packs/pixel-crawler for future cherry-picking. Swappable for a paid pack later with no contract change (tags are stable; only `art`/`from`/geometry move).
